limits:
A SEPARATE registration from controls/flow-wave-registry on the SAME gate (the harness supports several registrations per gate, #986): that one's detect_signal fires on a FILE-LANE overlap WARNING from a report-only arm where `list` always exits 0; this one fires on `list` REFUSING to answer at all. Different signal, different reason, so bundling them would risk one case passing on the other's signal - the exact hazard a shared alternation creates.

WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES (issue #1403): a registry.json that opens fine but is not exactly one JSON object document - trailing garbage after an otherwise-valid document, in the bad case here - makes `list` REFUSE (exit 3, FLOW_WAVE: error, a message naming invalid content) rather than silently compute zero roles from a streaming jq's partial parse and report 'no roles registered for wave cpp', FLOW_WAVE: listed, exit 0. The good case is the genuinely empty registry (`{}`, one valid document with no roles), which must keep reading as a clean, ordinary empty roster.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. Nothing about register/release/get/verify, which have their own, older protection via entry_json/entry_read_or_die (#1014 Part 2) and their own control coverage via tests/test_flow_wave_registry.py's parametrized corrupt-registry class - this control's fixture (list only) does not exercise those verbs at all. Nothing about `list --any-live`, which validates the identical document shape itself, inline, before this fix would ever run for that path, and already answered `undeterminable`/exit 2 on this same corrupt file before #1403 - this fix runs strictly AFTER that branch's own exit, by construction, so it cannot be the thing demonstrated here. Nothing about `lane-check`, which gets the identical fix but is not this gate's `list` verb and has its own pytest coverage instead (test_lane_check_reports_a_corrupt_registry_not_an_unregistered_role) rather than a dedicated control, since lane-check's own existing control registration is scoped to a different question (the diff-vs-lane comparison) and this would not fit it.

THE BAD FIXTURE'S SHAPE: 'trailing garbage after an object' specifically, not every malformed shape this fix also refuses (two concatenated documents, a bare array) - those are pinned by the pytest parametrization (test_list_reports_a_corrupt_registry_not_an_empty_roster), not duplicated here. A control's job is to prove the fix is NOT blind on a real input, not to re-walk the whole parametrized matrix a unit test already owns.

anchors.why: HISTORICAL, vendored byte-for-byte from 49ff7c2, the commit this branch was built from - the script exactly as it stood before this fix. MEASURED against the bad case: it reports 'no roles registered for wave cpp', FLOW_WAVE: listed, exit 0 - the false-clean collapse issue #1403 (absorbing Nit Store #864) found, reproduced from the control rather than asserted, and what makes the post-fix green a change in the gate rather than a change in the case.
